messages:
Tara (Sales): FYI: CapitalEdge wants a 30-day Dedicated POC in us-west-2. Must have static egress IP(s) for their firewall. They also asked if we can support mTLS to the endpoint and who handles cert rotation. Need a procurement-ready line item: "30d Dedicated POC + mTLS ops". cc @Marco @Yuki

Marco (Solutions): We can do it. Options: single EIP (fast, single point) or two EIPs for HA. mTLS is supported on Dedicated but requires ops to upload customer CA/client certs. We'll add a one-time mTLS setup fee. Need expected concurrency to price the pool.

Yuki (Network): Networking notes: outbound NAT EIPs per pool. We provide the EIP(s) as /32s for allowlisting. We can also publish a stable DNS alias but recommend pinning IPs. TLS only on 443, SNI required.

Sam (Infra): infra-bot: provisioning request received for small dedicated pool in us-west-2. ETA ~2 hours. Reserving 2 EIPs unless customer insists on single.

Rita (Security): For procurement: we'll attach SOC2. mTLS process: customer supplies CA bundle (PEM) + rotation cadence. They own cert rotation; we require 72h notice before swap. For Private deployments customer-managed KMS is supported; for Dedicated we manage endpoint keys unless they use Private.

Marco (Solutions): Action: I'll send a 30-day quote + one-time mTLS ops line item within 3 business hours. Also ask the customer for qps/concurrency and their cert bundle if they want mTLS.

Yuki (Network): Firewall test once IPs are provided and you have a POC key:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \
  --resolve dedicated-us-west-2.redwood.example:443:198.51.100.99 \
  "https://dedicated-us-west-2.redwood.example/v1/chat" \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'
```
This forces the hostname to the reserved EIP for validation.

Tara (Sales): I'll ask CapitalEdge for concurrency and whether they accept single-IP risk. Marco  please post quote when ready. Sam/Yuki  please confirm real IPs in-thread once provisioned. :thumbsup:
